zh-CN.title: 主角按键，轻盈随行
items: 登场按键以透明面板展示，三秒后自动收起为可拖拽、吸附边缘的浮钮
浮钮展示十分钟冷却倒计时，冷却结束后可再次展开

en.title: Entrance keys, always within reach
items: Transparent entrance keys fold into a draggable, edge-snapping control after three seconds
The floating control shows the ten-minute cooldown and reopens when ready
